metadata.question: Does the vegetation browning in Denmark increase in July 2018 compared to July 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 SR collection (COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for Denmark - Compare July 2017 vs July 2018 - Focus on NDVI as vegetation health indicator - Denmark bounds: approximately [8.0, 54.5, 15.2, 57.8] 2. Masking strategy: - Must mask clouds since we're comparing vegetation health - Use QA60 band for cloud masking in Sentinel-2 - The question is about vegetation browning, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Calculate mean NDVI for both periods - Check if collections have images (C1) - Check if valid pixels remain after masking (C2) - Check if NDVI values are valid (between -1 and 1) (C3) - "Browning increase" means NDVI decreased from 2017 to 2018 - If NDVI_2018 < NDVI_2017, answer A (Yes, browning increased) - Otherwise answer B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Denmark geometry const denmark = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([8.0, 54.5, 15.2, 57.8]); // 2. Time periods const date2017Start = '2017-07-01'; const date2017End = '2017-07-31'; const date2018Start = '2018-07-01'; const date2018End = '2018-07-31'; // 3. Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 4. Calculate NDVI function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // 5. Get Sentinel-2 data for July 2017 let col2017 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(denmark) .filterDate(date2017Start, date2017End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2017 = await col2017.size().getInfo(); console.log('2017 July images:', size2017); if (size2017 === 0) { console.log('No images found for July 2017'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Get Sentinel-2 data for July 2018 let col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(denmark) .filterDate(date2018Start, date2018End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addNDVI); const size2018 = await col2018.size().getInfo(); console.log('2018 July images:', size2018); if (size2018 === 0) { console.log('No images found for July 2018'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 7. Calculate median NDVI composites const ndvi2017 = col2017.select('NDVI').median(); const ndvi2018 = col2018.select('NDVI').median(); // 8. Calculate statistics with pixel count check const stats2017 = await ndvi2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: denmark, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2017 = stats2017.NDVI_mean; const count2017 = stats2017.NDVI_count; console.log('2017 Stats - Mean NDVI:', mean2017, 'Pixels:', count2017); if (count2017 === 0 || count2017 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2017 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } const stats2018 = await ndvi2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: denmark, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean2018 = stats2018.NDVI_mean; const count2018 = stats2018.NDVI_count; console.log('2018 Stats - Mean NDVI:', mean2018, 'Pixels:', count2018); if (count2018 === 0 || count2018 === null) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2018 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 9. Validation if (mean2017 === null || mean2018 === null || isNaN(mean2017) || isNaN(mean2018) || mean2017 < -1 || mean2017 > 1 || mean2018 < -1 || mean2018 > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI values detected'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 10. Final comparison const ndviChange = mean2018 - mean2017; console.log('NDVI Change (2018-2017):', ndviChange.toFixed(4)); // Browning increase means NDVI decreased (more browning in 2018) if (mean2018 < mean2017) { console.log('Vegetation browning increased in July 2018'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vegetation browning did not increase in July 2018'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
